methodology.cold: One first parse in each fresh Node process, after require/corpus IO and forced GC; startup/imports excluded.
methodology.warm: Same first child, after its cold parse and warmup additional parses; consecutive single-call samples, no forced GC between them.
methodology.construction: Every timed call includes a new Parser. Default HTML uses exported parse; plugins and AST use new Parser(opts).parse.
methodology.memory: Signed heapUsed after minus before each call, outside the timer. NET HEAP CHANGE, not allocated bytes; GC can make it negative.
methodology.validation: Every timed result including plugin traces/errors is hashed and checked against the frozen golden outside the timer.
